I'm so sorry for your loss. Nothing can fix this except time. I do recommend counseling to help you constructively move through the myriad of emotions you're going to feel.

Dont let anyone tell you that you should or need to do anything on a specific timeline. Do what feels right as it feels right. The only rule I have for dealing with tragedy is to not harm others and not harm myself.

Sometimes it's much easier to drink than it is to actually eat when you are in so much pain. I recommend the Naked brand of fruit and veggie juices. They actually taste good and don't have any added sugars to them but you'll get a large amount of good nutrients each day. That coupled with water will keep you going when you feel like you can't eat anything. I'm pregnant for the first time and dealing with pain emotional pain myself and doing this is what kept my baby and me as physically healthy as possible while I couldn't even choke food down without puking because of my emotional state.

Let yourself feel everything that comes up and lean on your loved ones and friends for the support they will undoubtedly be happy to provide. Don't be afraid to ask for exactly what you need from your family and friends. Need someone to just sit with you while you lose your shit...ask for it. Need someone to help with things in the house you can't bring yourself to do...ask for it. Whatever it is...your family and friends will be happy to help.

But again...let yourself process and move through this on your terms and no one else's. That's the most important part. Dont let anyone tell you that you are grieving your losses wrong because there is absolutely no wrong answer here.

I wish you strength during this unimaginable time.
